rules.rule: replace machine paths with repo-relative paths or named repo labels; no home-directory absolute paths in public projected artifacts except governance records that explicitly document local repo truth
summarize package/version/result only; omit command stdout/stderr and credential readiness detail
state published/verified package versions and links/registry facts; do not include auth context, local temp paths, raw npm/twine logs, or token references
project only public owner identity/current copyright conclusions; keep private owner decision evidence out
state public optional tooling package and required README/package gate harmonization; do not imply republish without owner authorization
describe @mplp/compliance as legacy alias boundary/excluded from current release-set; no deprecation action unless separately authorized
describe @mplp/validator as internal CI-only and absent from npm; do not include in publish set
state stale/not-needed/needed decision and follow-up goal; do not mutate downstream repos in Protocol projection execution unless owner scopes it
